high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "uncover.quantum." The post features a scientific video titled "Atoms in Motion: Gold Nanoparticles at 900 °C." The video was captured using a transmission electron microscope (TEM) to observe the behavior of gold nanoparticles on iron oxide at high temperatures. Image Content: The top part of the image shows a microscopic view of two gold nanoparticles sitting on the surface of iron oxide. The scale bar indicates that the magnification is 5 nanometers.
